A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 53-page PhyloLM paper, including Appendices A–K. Text, PDF-object and rendered-page comparisons establish that only the first-page arXiv stamp and associated link and metadata differ.

before.justification: v4 reports original experiments reconstructing LLM relationships and predicting benchmark scores in Section 3, with additional quantization and sensitivity results in the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains the same original empirical results, including genealogy reconstruction, benchmark prediction, quantization analysis and hyperparameter studies.

M1.justification: Sections 2.1–2.6 and Appendix C retain identical PhyloLM procedures, four-character output alignment, neighbor-joining trees and ICA/logistic-regression benchmark prediction.

E1.justification: Open-Web-Math, MBXP, the six prediction benchmarks and the evaluated model populations are unchanged. Appendix J retains the same Chinese-poetry, chat-style and Wikipedia scenarios.

E2.justification: The same ground-truth genealogy and benchmark-score comparisons are retained. No comparison method is added, removed or revised in corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Context/probe settings, sampling parameters, model configurations, metrics and leave-one-family-out evaluation are identical. All appendix experimental protocols also remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The hyperparameter studies, quantization analysis, alternative gene-set investigations and gene/completion-length sensitivity analyses are identical in Section 3.1 and Appendices D, H, J and K.

E5.justification: Both retain the eight independently sampled gene sets for matrix-variability estimation, standard-error bars, correlation tests and confidence-interval reporting. No repetition or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including the mean benchmark-prediction correlation of 0.68 ± 0.04 in Section 3.3, the statistics in Tables 4–5 and every appendix result plot.

T1.justification: Equation 1, the similarity-to-distance transformation and mathematical definitions and assumptions throughout the methods and appendices are identical. No proof or derivation changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same claims about recovering LLM relationships from outputs and efficiently predicting benchmark performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are identical, including common-ancestor complications, chat-API prompting bias, untested temperature effects and imperfect benchmark prediction. Appendix explanations and qualifications are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Code and notebook links, hardware and sampling details in Appendix B, pseudocode in Appendix C and data-processing instructions are identical. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The references and the positioning of PhyloLM relative to phylogenetics and LLM evaluation research are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v4, dated 1 October 2025, to v5, dated 8 December 2025. Manuscript wording, headings and section order remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, axes, legends and their placements are identical throughout the main text and appendices. The version-stamp update leaves the manuscript layout unchanged.

improvement.justification: The scientific manuscript and Appendices A–K are identical. Updating only the arXiv version/date stamp, associated self-link and PDF metadata produces no meaningful difference in scientific quality, clarity or reproducibility.
